name: Shell History
description: Keeps your bash, zsh and fish history across rebuilds and Codespaces via a Docker named volume, dedicated to this devcontainer. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

username.description: Container user whose shells keep their history. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

maxHistorySize.description: Number of history entries to keep, in memory and in the history file (bash and zsh).
